{{Top|leg}}
The '''Narjams''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of flat blue [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] that managed to colonize many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] due to their ability to grow on the oil reserves of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Once they found themselves on a new world, they would often contract a local disease and pass a mutated variant of it back to the locals and native ecosystems through their bites.
